checklist.title: Try wonton noodles; confirm broth contains no beef
Try claypot rice; avoid beef versions
Have a proper Hong Kong seafood meal
Try a Portuguese egg tart in Macau
Try a Macau pork chop bun
Carry HK$100–200 in small notes for Canal Road Flyover if participating
checklist.description: Use the existing Hong Kong cash reserve. Confirm the ritual price before starting; do not create a spend unless you participate.

checklist.title: Prebook Aqua Luna Christmas sailing with Symphony of Lights
Prebook early Peak Tram if advance booking is available
Prebook 07:30 TurboJET Sheung Wan → Macau Outer Harbour
Prebook around 22:00 Taipa → Sheung Wan ferry
Prebook Ngong Ping 360 one-way Crystal Cabin
Book Hong Kong Disneyland for 30 December
Recheck official NYE fireworks, crowd-control zones and MTR hours
Golden Reel if Bungy finishes on time and operating calendar permits
Take a short Tai O village boat ride if operating

itinerary.title: Vietnam Airlines VN982: Bengaluru to Hanoi (transit)
itinerary.transportInstructions: Departed Bengaluru Kempegowda International Airport, Terminal 2, at 23:35 on 24 Dec (arrives Hanoi Noi Bai Terminal 2 at 05:50 on 25 Dec). Economy Lite; seat 14E; one checked bag. Hindu meal request confirmed. This is the first leg of the Hong Kong journey, with a Hanoi transit, not a separate booking.

itinerary.title: Vietnam Airlines VN592: Hanoi to Hong Kong
itinerary.transportInstructions: Depart Hanoi Noi Bai International Airport, Terminal 2, at 10:35; arrive Hong Kong International Airport, Terminal 1, at 13:30. Economy Lite; seat 30A; one checked bag. Seafood meal request confirmed. Continuation of the Bengaluru → Hanoi → Hong Kong journey.

itinerary.title: Land at Hong Kong International Airport
itinerary.transportInstructions: Allow 60–90 minutes for immigration, baggage, toilets, SIM/eSIM if required, Octopus and cash/ATM.

details.quickNote: Clear immigration, collect bags, connect both phones, withdraw only a small amount of HKD if needed, then take A21. Do not buy Tourist/On-Loan Octopus at the airport by default.
details.payWith: Contactless card for A21; cash only as a backup.
details.fallback: Airport Express to Kowloon + taxi if road traffic or luggage convenience makes it worthwhile.

itinerary.title: A21 Airport Bus to Yau Ma Tei
itinerary.transportInstructions: Take A21 towards Kowloon and get off around Yau Ma Tei. Recommended with luggage; avoids MTR interchanges.

transportOptions.label: A21 airport bus
transportOptions.instructions: Direct luggage-friendly bus towards Yau Ma Tei; pay contactless if Octopus is not yet set up.

transportOptions.label: Airport Express + taxi
transportOptions.instructions: Use only if traffic is unusually bad or convenience outweighs the higher price.

details.quickNote: After hotel check-in, buy two physical On-Loan Adult Octopus cards at Yau Ma Tei MTR and load HK$400–500 each.

itinerary.title: Tsim Sha Tsui Christmas walk
itinerary.transportInstructions: Walk Yau Ma Tei → Jordan → Tsim Sha Tsui in about 30–40 minutes, or use MTR if tired. Prioritise harbour, Clock Tower, Star Ferry Pier, Avenue of Stars, Harbour City/K11 surroundings and Christmas installations.

itinerary.title: Aqua Luna and Symphony of Lights
itinerary.transportInstructions: Board at the Tsim Sha Tsui boarding point. Choose sailing including the 20:00 Symphony of Lights.

details.quickNote: Prebook the Christmas sailing that includes the 20:00 Symphony of Lights.

itinerary.title: Dinner around Tsim Sha Tsui / Jordan / Yau Ma Tei
itinerary.transportInstructions: Keep arrival-night dinner spontaneous. No beef and preferably no beef broth.

itinerary.title: Optional short Temple Street walk and snack
Travel to Peak Tram Central Terminus
itinerary.transportInstructions: Yau Ma Tei MTR → Central, then walk about 10–15 minutes to the Peak Tram terminus.

details.weather: Weather checkpoint: on 25 December evening, check Peak visibility, cloud base, rain and mist. Keep the early Peak plan when reasonably clear; otherwise make it movable and continue with Happy Valley/Central.
details.quickNote: Boxing Day: wake 06:15, leave hotel 06:40, reach terminus about 07:10–07:15.

transportOptions.label: MTR + walk
transportOptions.instructions: Fastest reliable early-morning route to the Lower Terminus.

transportOptions.label: Taxi
transportOptions.instructions: Use only if delayed or MTR timing is risky.

itinerary.title: Peak Tram up
itinerary.transportInstructions: Buy single journey UP only; descend later by Bus 15.

details.quickNote: Buy a single journey UP only; do not default to a return ticket.
details.weather: First Peak visit is daylight / Lugard Road; Sky Terrace 428 is optional.

itinerary.title: Victoria Peak and Lugard Road
itinerary.transportInstructions: Prioritise Lugard Road / part of Peak Circle Walk. Sky Terrace 428 is optional and not necessary if visibility is good.

itinerary.title: Bus 15 down from The Peak
itinerary.transportInstructions: Take scenic Bus 15 down towards Central/Hong Kong Island.

transportOptions.label: Bus 15
transportOptions.instructions: Scenic direct descent toward Central / Happy Valley.

transportOptions.label: Green Minibus 1
transportOptions.instructions: Use if the Bus 15 queue is significantly worse.

transportOptions.label: Peak Tram
transportOptions.instructions: Only if its queue is short.

itinerary.title: Cheung Hing Coffee Shop breakfast
itinerary.transportInstructions: Try pineapple bun, pineapple bun with butter, egg tart and Hong Kong milk tea.

itinerary.title: Happy Valley to Central by Ding Ding
itinerary.transportInstructions: Use Hong Kong Tramways for part of the journey; sit upstairs if possible.

itinerary.title: Central / Old Town walking route
itinerary.transportInstructions: Central streets, Mid-Levels Escalator, Graham Street, Old Town Central and Hollywood Road.

itinerary.title: Lunch around Central
itinerary.transportInstructions: Casual cha chaan teng / roast meat rice / pork or chicken noodles / baked pork chop rice / dim sum. Avoid beef/broth.

itinerary.title: Star Ferry Central → Tsim Sha Tsui
Jordan / Yau Ma Tei dinner
itinerary.transportInstructions: Choose Jordan noodles or spontaneous Temple Street meal. Confirm noodle broth contains no beef.

itinerary.title: Luk On Kui old-school dim sum
itinerary.transportInstructions: Yau Ma Tei → Central → Sheung Wan, then walk. Try har gow, siu mai, char siu bao, cheung fun, ribs, turnip cake and tea.

itinerary.title: Man Mo Temple
itinerary.transportInstructions: Walk 10–15 minutes uphill from Luk On Kui along/near Hollywood Road. Pay attention to street names as GPS orientation can be confusing.

details.quickNote: Traditional temple dedicated to Man Cheong (literature) and Mo Tai (war). Allow a short cultural visit; respect worshippers and do not block prayers.

itinerary.title: Sham Shui Po exploration
itinerary.transportInstructions: Walk to Sheung Wan MTR, then continue to Sham Shui Po. Explore Apliu Street, Fuk Wing Street, Pei Ho Street and side streets; snack rather than have a large formal lunch.

itinerary.title: Mong Kok markets and streets
itinerary.transportInstructions: Suggested route: Goldfish Market → Fa Yuen Street → Sneaker Street → Ladies' Market. Add street snacks around 15:30.

itinerary.title: Walk Mong Kok → Yau Ma Tei
itinerary.transportInstructions: Walk south; the transition through Kowloon is part of the experience.

itinerary.title: Hing Kee Claypot Rice
itinerary.transportInstructions: Choose chicken, pork or Chinese sausage claypot rice. Avoid beef versions.

itinerary.title: Kai Kai Dessert
itinerary.transportInstructions: Try black sesame paste, walnut sweet soup, mango desserts or traditional Chinese sweet soups.

itinerary.title: Taxi to Hong Kong Macau Ferry Terminal
itinerary.transportInstructions: Use taxi from Yau Ma Tei because of the early start; target terminal by 06:35–06:45.

transportOptions.label: Taxi
transportOptions.instructions: Very early departure: protects the 07:30 ferry booking.

transportOptions.label: MTR
transportOptions.instructions: Only if first-train timing is comfortably safe.

details.fallback: Use a taxi whenever ferry timing is at risk.

itinerary.title: TurboJET Sheung Wan → Macau Outer Harbour

details.quickNote: Prebook target 07:30 departure; allow time for immigration and boarding.

itinerary.title: Walk to Ruins of St Paul's via historic streets
itinerary.transportInstructions: Walk through pedestrian streets, bakeries, almond-cookie and snack shops.

itinerary.title: Macanese / Portuguese lunch
itinerary.transportInstructions: Look for Portuguese-style chicken, pork dishes, seafood or Macanese rice. Also try Portuguese egg tart and pork chop bun. No beef.

transportOptions.label: Taxi
transportOptions.instructions: Time-sensitive Bungy booking; save time from historic Macau.

transportOptions.label: Macau bus
transportOptions.instructions: Prefer buses when time is not tight.

itinerary.title: Macau Tower and Bungy block
itinerary.transportInstructions: Allow full block for registration, weighing, briefing, equipment, waiting, jump, photos/video and observation. Bungy cost intentionally excluded from budget.

details.quickNote: Target 14:00–14:30 booking. Bungy is intentionally excluded from general trip-budget totals.

itinerary.title: Golden Reel at Studio City
itinerary.transportInstructions: Only do this if Bungy finishes by roughly 16:00 and energy is good; otherwise go directly to Cotai.

details.fallback: Skip without regret; historic Macau, Bungy and the Cotai resorts take priority.

itinerary.title: Travel to Taipa Ferry Terminal
itinerary.transportInstructions: Preferred order: free resort shuttle if convenient, public bus, taxi if timing becomes tight.

itinerary.title: Ferry Taipa → Hong Kong Sheung Wan
itinerary.transportInstructions: Book 22:00 sailing; 23:00 acts as backup.

itinerary.title: Return to Bridal Tea House
itinerary.transportInstructions: Use MTR only if comfortably operating; otherwise take taxi.

itinerary.title: MTR Yau Ma Tei → Tung Chung
itinerary.transportInstructions: Yau Ma Tei → Lai King → Tung Chung.

itinerary.title: Ngong Ping 360 Crystal Cabin one-way
itinerary.transportInstructions: One-way only: Tung Chung → Ngong Ping. Continue later by bus to Tai O and bus back to Tung Chung.

details.quickNote: Crystal Cabin, one-way only. Do not buy a round-trip ticket.

itinerary.title: Vegetarian lunch around Po Lin / Ngong Ping
itinerary.transportInstructions: Vegetarian meal is an easy way to avoid beef/broth issues.

itinerary.title: Bus Ngong Ping → Tai O
itinerary.transportInstructions: Use public bus; recheck Route 21 timetable shortly before travel because service is less frequent.

itinerary.title: Tai O Fishing Village
itinerary.transportInstructions: Explore stilt houses, canals, fishing-village streets, seafood shops and local stores.

details.payWith: Cash is useful for small local operators.

itinerary.title: Bus Tai O → Tung Chung
itinerary.transportInstructions: Take direct public bus back to Tung Chung.

itinerary.title: Return to Yau Ma Tei
itinerary.transportInstructions: Tung Chung → Lai King → Yau Ma Tei by MTR.

details.fallback: If visibility, rain, energy or arrival time are poor, return straight to Yau Ma Tei.

itinerary.title: Optional second Peak at night
itinerary.transportInstructions: From Tung Chung, stay on the Tung Chung Line to Hong Kong Station/Central; take Bus 15 or Minibus 1 up. Return by Bus 15, Minibus 1 or Peak Tram depending on queues.

details.weather: Optional, weather dependent and energy dependent. Check visibility, cloud and rain on 29 December afternoon.
details.fareForTwo: about HK$52 using Bus 15 both ways, excluding minor MTR differences

transportOptions.label: Minibus 1
transportOptions.instructions: Use if it offers a meaningfully shorter queue.

transportOptions.label: Peak Tram
transportOptions.instructions: Use only if the down queue is short.

details.fallback: Skip and return to Yau Ma Tei if conditions or energy are poor.

itinerary.title: Temple Street or Mong Kok night food
itinerary.transportInstructions: Choose based on energy. Curry fish balls, siu mai, cheung fun, egg waffles, fried snacks and milk tea; avoid beef.

itinerary.title: MTR to Hong Kong Disneyland
itinerary.transportInstructions: Yau Ma Tei → Lai King → Sunny Bay → Disneyland Resort Line.

itinerary.title: Hong Kong Disneyland full day
itinerary.transportInstructions: Prioritise World of Frozen, Big Grizzly Mountain, Mystic Manor and Iron Man Experience; fit Festival of the Lion King and PhilharMagic around wait times; stay for nighttime castle projection/fireworks if scheduled.

itinerary.title: Return Disneyland → Yau Ma Tei
itinerary.transportInstructions: Disneyland Resort → Sunny Bay → Lai King → Yau Ma Tei.

itinerary.title: Relaxed breakfast and local morning
itinerary.transportInstructions: Australia Dairy Company, cha chaan teng, bakery or local café. Keep the morning close to Yau Ma Tei/Jordan.

itinerary.title: Easy local morning
itinerary.transportInstructions: Choose Kowloon Park, Jordan streets, Nathan Road, daytime Temple Street, Harbour City/K11 or a café. Do not travel far.

itinerary.title: Wing Fat Seafood lunch
itinerary.transportInstructions: Major seafood meal before NYE crowds. Try roast pigeon, razor clams, seafood, fish and Chinese broccoli. Avoid beef.

itinerary.title: Rest and prepare for New Year's Eve
Walk Yau Ma Tei → Tsim Sha Tsui
itinerary.transportInstructions: Walk via Jordan because road closures/crowd controls may affect transport later.

itinerary.title: Tsim Sha Tsui waterfront before countdown
itinerary.transportInstructions: Stay around Harbour City, Clock Tower, Cultural Centre, Avenue of Stars, K11 surroundings and Victoria Harbour. Eat a substantial early dinner/snack around 17:30–18:00 and use toilets.

itinerary.title: Secure NYE countdown location
itinerary.transportInstructions: Choose exact viewing area after official 2026 arrangements are announced. Once crowds become dense, stop moving.

itinerary.title: Hong Kong New Year's countdown
itinerary.transportInstructions: Victoria Harbour skyline, countdown and fireworks if officially confirmed.

itinerary.title: Late brunch near Yau Ma Tei / Jordan
MTR Yau Ma Tei → Kennedy Town
itinerary.transportInstructions: Yau Ma Tei → Central → Kennedy Town.

itinerary.title: West-to-east Ding Ding journey
itinerary.transportInstructions: Board an eastbound tram, sit upstairs, and enjoy Kennedy Town → Sheung Wan → Central. The journey itself is the attraction.

itinerary.title: Wan Chai stop
itinerary.transportInstructions: Older streets and a short local walk, bakery or cha chaan teng. Keep this short: leave around 13:45 for Canal Road Flyover.

itinerary.title: Canal Road Flyover villain hitting
itinerary.transportInstructions: Walk or use a short tram segment from Wan Chai. Watch the Da Siu Yan folk ritual, or participate if interested; keep moving by about 14:20 to protect the Monster Building daylight target.

details.attractionCost: about HK$50–100 if participating; observation is free
details.payWith: Cash preferred; confirm the price before starting.
details.quickNote: Optional cultural experience, not a generic blessing service. Be respectful to practitioners and participants; frame participation around obstacles or bad luck, not a real person.
details.fallback: Skip participation or shorten Causeway Bay first if running late.

itinerary.title: Causeway Bay stop
itinerary.transportInstructions: Times Square area, Hysan Place surroundings and side streets. Do not let this stop overrun; Monster Building before dark matters more.

itinerary.title: North Point and Chun Yeung Street
itinerary.transportInstructions: Explore the local market environment; optional small street snack.

itinerary.title: Monster Building
itinerary.transportInstructions: Arrive while there is useful daylight. Residential complex: be respectful, do not block entrances, enter private areas, photograph residents closely or make excessive noise.

itinerary.title: Return to Yau Ma Tei and rest
itinerary.transportInstructions: Walk to Tai Koo or Quarry Bay MTR → Admiralty → Yau Ma Tei; rest 30–45 minutes at hotel.

itinerary.title: Final Mong Kok street-food crawl
itinerary.transportInstructions: Pick multiple small items: curry fish balls, siu mai, cheung fun, egg waffles, fried snacks/squid, milk tea and dessert. Avoid beef.

itinerary.title: Walk Mong Kok → Yau Ma Tei and pack
Breakfast if flight timing permits
itinerary.transportInstructions: Eat locally before leaving if time permits: cha chaan teng/bakery, milk tea, eggs/toast or pineapple bun.

itinerary.title: A21 Yau Ma Tei → Hong Kong International Airport
itinerary.transportInstructions: Leave approximately 4h15–4h30 before flight departure. Target airport around 3 hours before departure. Taxi to Kowloon Station + Airport Express is the backup if timing/traffic/luggage requires it.

itinerary.title: Vietnam Airlines VN593: Hong Kong to Hanoi (transit)
itinerary.transportInstructions: Depart Hong Kong International Airport, Terminal 1, at 14:30; arrive Hanoi Noi Bai International Airport, Terminal 2, at 15:40. Economy Classic; seat 14B; one checked bag. Seafood meal request confirmed. Hanoi is a transit stop, not a separate booking.

itinerary.title: Vietnam Airlines VN983: Hanoi to Bengaluru
itinerary.transportInstructions: Depart Hanoi Noi Bai International Airport, Terminal 2, at 19:10; arrive Bengaluru Kempegowda International Airport, Terminal 2, at 22:25 local time. Economy Classic; one checked bag. Final leg of the Hong Kong → Hanoi → Bengaluru return journey.

importantNotes.title: No beef / no beef broth
importantNotes.body: Show or say: 唔要牛肉，唔要牛湯。豬肉、雞肉、海鮮都可以。 This means: no beef and no beef soup/broth; pork, chicken and seafood are okay. Ask when noodle broth is unclear.

importantNotes.title: How to pay in Hong Kong
importantNotes.body: Use physical Octopus for MTR, buses, Ding Ding, Star Ferry, convenience stores and small purchases. Use card for larger meals, tickets and shopping. Keep HK$1,500–2,000 total cash as a backup for markets, street food, Tai O and older restaurants.

importantNotes.title: Getting HKD cash and avoiding DCC
importantNotes.body: Use a debit/forex card at an ATM with reasonable overseas fees. Never use a normal credit card for cash unless its terms explicitly allow it. At an ATM or card terminal, always choose HKD; decline INR conversion / guaranteed INR amount / ATM conversion.

importantNotes.title: Two physical On-Loan Adult Octopus cards
importantNotes.body: After check-in, buy two physical On-Loan Adult Octopus cards at Yau Ma Tei MTR Customer Service Centre. Load about HK$400–500 each. HK$50 deposit is refundable; unused balance is refundable, but an early-return handling fee may apply. Refund remaining value and deposit before leaving if practical.

importantNotes.title: Both phones online
importantNotes.body: Preferred: SoSIM, about HK$33 per person, with real-name registration. Buy the Greater China one-day Macau roaming package before 28 December (about HK$10). Alternative physical SIM: CMHK 4G MySIM from 7-Eleven. Verify WhatsApp, Maps, transport apps and TripBoard on both phones.

importantNotes.title: Apps to install
importantNotes.body: Install Citybus, KMB / APP1933, HK Tramways, MTR Mobile, HKeMobility, Google Maps and WhatsApp on both phones. Use operator apps for live vehicle information; in dense areas, check street names and MTR exit letters rather than trusting the rotating GPS arrow alone.

importantNotes.title: Arrival at Hong Kong Airport
importantNotes.body: Clear immigration; collect luggage; connect mobile data; finish SIM registration if needed; get only a small amount of HKD; take A21 and pay contactless if Octopus is not ready; check in; then buy the two On-Loan Octopus cards at Yau Ma Tei MTR. Do not exchange a large amount at the airport.

importantNotes.title: Pre-trip rechecks
importantNotes.body: Around November/early December, recheck Aqua Luna Christmas timetable, Peak Tram and Ngong Ping maintenance, ferry schedules, Golden Reel calendar, Disneyland hours/show and restaurant holiday hours. On 25 Dec check Peak visibility; on 29 Dec check night-Peak conditions; before NYE check the official programme, crowd control and MTR arrangements.

importantNotes.title: Where to eat spontaneously
importantNotes.body: Temple Street/Yau Ma Tei: claypot rice, seafood, dai pai dong-style meals and desserts. Mong Kok: curry fish balls, siu mai, cheung fun, egg waffles and snacks. Jordan: wonton noodles, Kai Kai Dessert, Australia Dairy Company and cha chaan tengs. Temple Street is not the only evening-food option.

importantNotes.title: Man Mo Temple
importantNotes.body: Traditional temple / heritage stop on 27 December after Luk On Kui. Hollywood Road, Sheung Wan; free; allow 30–40 minutes. Respect worshippers and do not block prayers or treat it solely as a photo location.

importantNotes.title: Canal Road Flyover villain hitting
importantNotes.body: Optional Da Siu Yan folk ritual on 1 January between Wan Chai and Causeway Bay. Watching is free; participation is approximately HK$50–100, cash preferred. Confirm price first. It is a living ritual—be respectful, and frame it around obstacles or bad luck rather than a real person.
